title: dryopteris caudiculata
intro: Dryopteris caudiculata, commonly known as the Caudiculated Wood Fern or Rattlesnake Fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, inflammation, and various other conditions. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris caudiculata include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
